title: Post Feed: the _runner extension on a JSON Feed item
description: Optional. Put it on any JSON Feed 1.1 item as "_runner". Every field may be left out; an item with no _runner block is read as kind news, priority normal, with a picture that is not used.

kind.description: What the item is about. Shapes how a post is written.

expires.description: Never posted after this moment (ISO 8601): the end of an offer, the start of an event.

claims.description: When given, the only claims a post about this item may make, each as you would say it.

characters.description: Recurring characters to feature, by the exact name your growth team knows them by.

rights.description: What you can say about the item's picture. Left out, the picture is not used.

owned.description: You own the picture or may let it be posted.

made_with_ai.description: The picture was made or edited with AI.

shows_real_person.description: The picture shows a real, identifiable person. It is then never posted from a feed: add that person's photo where their consent is recorded.

channels.description: Channels to post on, such as instagram or linkedin. Left out, the team chooses.

priority.description: push asks for it to be posted ahead of the team's own ideas.
